metadata.title: Extended stellar systems in the solar neighborhood. IV. Meingast 1: the most massive stellar stream in the solar neighborhood

notes: No eligible stars. The paper’s subject is the Meingast 1 stellar stream, not individual Galactic unbound stars: its “gravitationally unbound” language describes the stream/star-formation mode (T:p1-b0; T:p1-b13; T:p1-b17), not stars unbound from the Milky Way. The named stars 42 Ceti (T:p1-b19) and α Aquarii (T:p5-b5) are evaluated only as stream members or interlopers; α Aquarii is retained only as a low-fidelity stream member, not as a present-day Galactic unbound candidate.
